# `hyoword` v2.0 Declarative JSON Document Schema Reference

All MS Word (`.docx`) documents generated by `15_Word-Auto-Skill` are compiled from a single UTF-8 JSON file passed to `skill/scripts/build_doc.py`.

---

## 1. Top-Level Structure

```json
{
  "meta": { ... },
  "blocks": [ ... ]
}
```

---

## 2. `meta` Object Specification

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `doc_type` | `string` | `"technical_review"` | Document category (`"rfi_response"`, `"claim_position_paper"`, `"contract_redline"`, `"technical_spec"`, `"internal_technical_review"`, `"meeting_minutes"`). |
| `profile` | `string` | `"epc-en"` | Typography profile: `"epc-en"` / `"global-en"` (`Arial` + `맑은 고딕` + `Consolas` for Global English documents), `"modern"` / `"kr-modern"` (`Pretendard` + `Consolas` for Korean domestic/HQ documents), or `"safe"` (`Arial` + `맑은 고딕` + `Courier New`). |
| `language` | `string` | `"en"` (or `"ko"` if `modern`) | Primary document language (`"en"` or `"ko"`). Controls table labels, TOC header, and notes. |
| `project_name` | `string` | **Required** | Project name displayed on cover/header and metadata cards. |
| `doc_title` | `string` | **Required** | Main document title. |
| `header_title` | `string` | `meta.doc_title` | Optional shorter title for the running header on Page 2+. |
| `doc_subtitle` | `string` | `""` | Subtitle displayed below the main title on the cover or compact header banner. |
| `doc_number` | `string` | `"TBD"` | Document control number. |
| `revision` | `string` | `"0"` | Current revision identifier (`"0"`, `"A"`, `"1"`, etc.). |
| `issue_date` | `string` | `"YYYY-MM-DD"` | Issue date in ISO format (`YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `doc_status` | `string` | `"FOR REVIEW"` | Status pill text in the top-right badge (`"FOR REVIEW"`, `"ISSUED FOR APPROVAL"`, `"내부 기술 검토서"`). |
| `client` | `string` | `"-"` | Client / Owner / Recipient organization. |
| `contract_no` | `string` | `"-"` | Contract or package reference number. |
| `include_cover` | `boolean` | `true` | **`true` (Mode A)**: Full formal cover page + Section Break + Auto TOC + Abbreviations. **`false` (Mode B)**: Compact 1-page top metadata banner followed immediately by body blocks on Page 1. |
| `include_toc` | `boolean` | `true` (Mode A) | Whether to insert the automatic Word Table of Contents (`TOC \o "1-3" \h \z \u`). |
| `abbreviations` | `"auto"` \| `array` \| `null` | `null` | If `"auto"`, scans the entire JSON for Global & Korean EPC/Power/BESS acronyms (`IEC`, `IEEE`, `UL`, `NFPA`, `FIDIC`, `KEPCO`, `KPX`, `KEC`, `KS`, `KGS`, `ERCOT`, `CAISO`, `PJM`, `TSO`, `DSO`, `AEMO`, `NSP`, `GPS`, `BESS`, `PCS`, `BMS`, `EMS`, `GIS`, `ACB`, `VCB`, `EOT`, `LDs`, `ITP`, `FAT`, `SAT`, `PAC`, `FAC`, `RFI`, `BoP`, etc.) and populates the Abbreviations table automatically with only the terms used in the document. Can also be an explicit array of `{"term": "...", "description": "..."}`. |
| `approvals` | `object` | `{}` | Sign-off block with keys `prepared_by`, `checked_by`, `approved_by`, each containing `{"name": "...", "signature": "...", "date": "..."}`. Leave `signature` as `""` until the person actually signs; never pre-fill "Signed". |
| `revisions` | `array` | `[...]` | Revision history rows: `[{"rev": "0", "date": "2026-10-16", "description": "...", "author": "..."}]`. |
| `table_sums` | `array` | `[]` | Deterministic arithmetic audit rules checked before build: `[{"caption": "...", "column": 3, "expected": 100.0, "tolerance": 0.01}]`. |
| `author` | `string` | `""` | Value written to `docProps/core.xml` `dc:creator` (defaults to blank to scrub personal metadata). |

---

## 3. Inline Rich-Text & Redline Markup

Every text field in paragraphs, list items, callouts, and table cells supports inline markup. Markup may nest (for example `**bold with [TBC: ...]**`); the renderer parses inner markup recursively, and the build QA fails `--strict` if any raw `` ` ``, `**`, `~~` or `++` survives into the document text.

- `**bold text**` → Bold run
- `*italic text*` → Italic run
- `` `text` `` → Rendered as plain body text (no monospace, no tint). Do not use it for values, units or standards; see `writing_style.md`.
- `~~deleted baseline wording~~` → Contractual redline deletion (strikethrough `#B42318` on `#FEF3F2` rose tint)
- `++inserted proposed wording++` → Contractual redline insertion (bold underline `#6428E6` on `#EBE6FF` lavender tint)
- `[TO BE CONFIRMED: ...]` or `[확인 필요: ...]` → Hold marker in bold `#6428E6` text (no background tint)

---

## 4. `blocks[]` Catalog (14 Block Types)

### 4.1 `heading`
```json
{
  "type": "heading",
  "level": 1,
  "text": "Technical Assessment of Foundation Settlement",
  "numbered": true,
  "page_break_before": false
}
```
- `level`: `1` (`14.5pt` `#2E008B` with bottom rule), `2` (`12.0pt` `#6428E6`), `3` (`10.8pt` `#262633`), or `4` (`10.2pt` `#646478`).
- Automatic hierarchical numbering (`1.`, `1.1`, `1.1.1`) is applied when `"numbered": true` (default). Any duplicate manual leading numbers in `text` are stripped automatically.

### 4.2 `paragraph`
```json
{
  "type": "paragraph",
  "style": "body",
  "text": "Standard paragraph with **bold** text and a [TO BE CONFIRMED: source reference]."
}
```
- `style`: `"body"` (`10.2pt` `#262633`), `"lead"` (`10.8pt` `#14141F`), or `"note"` / `"guidance"` (`9.2pt` italic `#646478`).
- Alternatively pass `"paragraphs": ["...", "..."]` to render multiple consecutive paragraphs.

### 4.3 `clause_list` / `bullet_list`
```json
{
  "type": "clause_list",
  "scheme": "alpha",
  "items": [
    {
      "head": "OEM Erection Flatness Tolerance (`≤ 3 mm`)",
      "text": "Applies solely at initial placement.",
      "sub_items": [
        "Verified during Mechanical Completion ITP Stage 1.",
        "Compensated via SS316 leveling shims."
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```
- `scheme`: `"alpha"` (`(a), (b), (c)` with `(i), (ii), (iii)` sub-items), `"numbered"` (`1), 2), 3)`), or `"bullet"` (`•`, `▪`, `–`).

### 4.4 `callout`
```json
{
  "type": "callout",
  "kind": "executive_summary",
  "title": "Executive Position & Commercial Summary",
  "body": "Optional body paragraph(s).",
  "bullets": [
    "**First Point**: Detail...",
    "**Second Point**: Detail..."
  ]
}
```
- `kind`:
  - `"executive_summary"` (or `"summary"`): Deep Purple `#2E008B` left bar, `#F4F4F9` fill
  - `"key_takeaway"` (or `"takeaway"`): Main Purple `#6428E6` left bar, `#EBE6FF` fill
  - `"risk_warning"` (or `"warning"` / `"risk"`): Amber `#D97706` left bar, `#FFFBEB` fill
  - `"contract_hold"` (or `"hold"` / `"tbc"`): Red `#DC2626` left bar, `#FEF2F2` fill
  - `"draft_response"` (or `"response"` / `"info"`): Royal Blue `#0055B8` left bar, `#F0F7FF` fill

### 4.5 `kv_table`
```json
{
  "type": "kv_table",
  "caption": "Subject RFI & Interface Baseline Summary",
  "columns_mode": 4,
  "pairs": [
    {"key": "RFI Reference", "value": "`RFI-CIV-042`"},
    {"key": "Equipment Unit", "value": "20-ft Container (`42.5 tonnes`)"}
  ],
  "note": "Optional table footnote.",
  "source": "Optional source citation."
}
```
- `columns_mode`: `2` (Key | Value) or `4` (Key 1 | Value 1 | Key 2 | Value 2).

### 4.6 `table` / `spec_table`
```json
{
  "type": "table",
  "caption": "Comparison of OEM Enclosure Scope vs. BoP Designer Responsibilities",
  "columns": ["Interface Item", "Responsible Party", "Criterion", "Stage", "Status"],
  "col_widths_mm": [33.0, 27.0, 61.0, 26.0, 28.0],
  "theme": "solid",
  "grid": "horizontal",
  "shade_first_col": true,
  "zebra": true,
  "align": ["left", "left", "left", "center", "center"],
  "rows": [
    ["Container Pad Levelness", "EPC / Civil", "Achieve `≤ 3 mm` via SS316 shims", "ITP", "COMPLIANT"]
  ],
  "note": "Optional table note.",
  "source": "Optional source."
}
```
- Status cells containing exact tokens (`COMPLIANT`, `OPEN`, `HOLD`, `TBC`, `CLARIFICATION`, `NON-COMPLIANT`, `REJECTED`, `준수`, `보류`, `확인 필요`, `불가`, etc.) are automatically styled as semantic status pills.

### 4.7 `redline_comparison` / `comparison`
```json
{
  "type": "redline_comparison",
  "caption": "Contractual & Technical Position Redline Table",
  "rows": [
    {
      "clause": "Sub-Clause 4.10 / Civil Scope",
      "baseline": "Contractor shall ensure ~~no foundation settlement exceeds 3 mm over 20 years~~.",
      "proposed": "Contractor shall install enclosure within ++±3 mm erection flatness++ and design foundations per ++Geotechnical Report SLS criteria++.",
      "rationale": "Separates installation tolerance from geotechnical consolidation."
    }
  ]
}
```

### 4.8 `requirement_matrix`
```json
{
  "type": "requirement_matrix",
  "caption": "Applicable Standards & Specification Compliance Matrix",
  "rows": [
    {
      "id": "REQ-01",
      "clause": "OEM Manual Rev.2 §4.2",
      "requirement": "Co-planarity across support pads ≤ 3 mm at installation.",
      "status": "COMPLIANT",
      "position": "Achieved via SS316 shims during installation ITP."
    }
  ]
}
```

### 4.9 `open_items`
```json
{
  "type": "open_items",
  "caption": "Open Items & Required Clarifications",
  "items": [
    {
      "no": 1,
      "subject": "Civil Subcontract DNP Back-to-Back Terms",
      "clarification": "Provide executed Civil Subcontract Particular Conditions.",
      "impact": "Determines post-handover grouting liability allocation.",
      "status": "HOLD"
    }
  ]
}
```

### 4.10 `evidence_log`
```json
{
  "type": "evidence_log",
  "caption": "Source Documents & Evidence Traceability Log",
  "sources": [
    {
      "id": "REF-01",
      "title": "BESS Container Mechanical Installation Manual (`Rev.2`)",
      "grade": "E1",
      "status": "COMPLIANT"
    }
  ]
}
```

### 4.11 `abbreviations`
Renders an Abbreviations & Definitions table directly inside the body if needed outside front-matter.

### 4.12 `figure` / `image`
```json
{
  "type": "figure",
  "path": "assets/diagram.png",
  "width_mm": 150.0,
  "caption": "Single-Line Interface Diagram"
}
```

### 4.13 `page_break`
```json
{ "type": "page_break" }
```

### 4.14 `section_break`
Switches page orientation dynamically between Portrait (`175.0 mm` content width) and Landscape (`262.0 mm` content width):
```json
{
  "type": "section_break",
  "orientation": "landscape"
}
```
